Two syllables or more take more and most: more beautiful.

text: Degrees of comparison. One syllable takes er and est: tall, taller, tallest; double a final consonant: big, bigger. Y becomes i: happy, happier. Two syllables or more take more and most: more beautiful. And the irregulars: good, better, best; bad, worse, worst; far, farther or further; old, older or elder.
